guides.title: Set up direct deposit
guides.intro: Have your pay deposited straight into your bank account. *(Sample content: replace with your real procedure.)*
before: Have your bank's **routing number** (9 digits) and your **account number** ready.
You can find both at the bottom of a check or in your bank's app.

steps.text: Sign in to the **employee self-service portal**.
Go to **Pay** → **Direct Deposit**.
Click **Add account**.
Enter your **routing number** and **account number**, then choose **Checking** or **Savings**.
Choose how much to deposit: **the full amount** or a **set dollar amount / percentage**.
Review the details and click **Submit**.
steps.details: Changes usually take effect in 1–2 pay periods. You'll get a paper check until then.

troubleshooting: **Routing number rejected:** double-check it with your bank; some banks use a different number for direct deposit.
**Deposit didn't arrive:** contact Payroll with your pay date and the last 4 digits of the account.

guides.title: Reset your password
guides.intro: Use this guide if you forgot your password or your account is locked. *(Sample content: replace with your real procedure.)*
before: You need access to the email address or phone number on file.
If your account is locked after too many attempts, wait 15 minutes before trying again.

steps.text: Open the **employee sign-in page** in your web browser.
Under the password box, click **Forgot password?**
Enter your **employee ID or work email**, then click **Send reset link**.
steps.details: If you don't see the email within 5 minutes, check your junk/spam folder.

steps.text: Open the email and click **Reset my password**. The link expires after 30 minutes.
Choose a new password. It must be at least 12 characters and different from your last 5 passwords.
Click **Save**, then sign in with your new password.

troubleshooting: **No email arrived:** confirm the email on file with IT, then try again.
**Link expired:** go back to step 2 and request a new link.
**Still locked out:** contact the IT Help Desk.

guides.title: Update your tax withholding (W-4)
guides.intro: Change how much federal or state tax is taken out of each paycheck. *(Sample content: replace with your real procedure.)*
before: The IRS **Tax Withholding Estimator** can help you decide what to enter.

steps.text: Sign in to the **employee self-service portal**.
Go to **Pay** → **Tax Withholding**.
Choose **Federal (W-4)** or **State (DE 4)**.
Fill out the form. Each section has help text if you're unsure.
Sign electronically and click **Submit**.
steps.details: The change applies to the next payroll that hasn't been processed yet.

troubleshooting: **Not sure what to enter:** talk to a tax professional. Payroll staff can't give tax advice.

guides.title: View or download your pay stub
guides.intro: Find, view, and save your pay statements. *(Sample content: replace with your real procedure.)*

steps.text: Sign in to the **employee self-service portal**.
Go to **Pay** → **Pay Statements**.
Pick the **pay date** you want from the list.
Click **View** to see it, or **Download PDF** to save or print it.

troubleshooting: **Pay date not listed:** statements appear on the morning of payday.
**A number looks wrong:** contact Payroll before the next pay period.
